assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of symptomatic paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
CPT 93271 is ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic periods.
The diagnosis codes are I48.0, I34.0, and I49.5.
The reason code for the denial is PR-204.
The claim for Cardiac Event Monitoring (CPT 93271) has been denied.
